video_title: Boogie CALLS OUT Rudy Gobert! Can LaMelo Lead Wolves With Ant Out?

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' strategy for playing without Anthony Edwards
quotes.excerpt: They know they might have to go through each other one day down the road.
quotes.quote: They know these are two of the elite teams in the Western Conference. They know they might have to go through each other one day down the road. This is exactly why they make the move for LaMelo Ball. He has been in that position to be the guy. He has been in that position to be the leading scorer, ball in his hands at the end of the games. That is exactly what this team is going to need while Anthony Edwards is out. It is a long time, two months. They are going to need this version of LaMelo Ball. They are going to need Jaden McDaniels to throw in 16 to 20. Jaden McDaniels is still my favorite player in the NBA. He is still going to do a little bit of everything. Chris Finch is a phenomenal coach and he is going to have these guys playing defense no matter where the game is. This team can still win basketball games with their best player out because they have that much talent.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on Minnesota's depth and Bones Hyland
quotes.excerpt: I think Bones Hyland has a chance to be sixth man of the year.
quotes.quote: I think this is a situation that nobody was expecting as far as Anthony Edwards going down early. It also is shining a light on the rest of the talent that is on this group. I think Chris Finch did an incredible job of putting a team around Anthony Edwards this offseason. I am even going to go out on a limb, I am going to say it now, I think Bones Hyland has a chance to be sixth man of the year. They have a lot of depth, they have a lot of guard play. They have some high impact guards that can change the game, coming off the bench, starting, it doesn't matter. You have Kyle Anderson, 21 points, Bones Hyland 19 off the bench, Jaden McDaniels playing high-level basketball, Jaden McDaniels doing exactly what he does every night, and LaMelo leading the show. This is a well-rounded group.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins criticizes Rudy Gobert's lack of development
quotes.excerpt: It is unacceptable to be 10 plus years in the league and still not be able to catch the basketball.
quotes.quote: It is unacceptable to be 10 plus years in the league and still not be able to catch the basketball. It is a bit frustrating to see, but I understand what they feel like he brings to the game, and that is the rim protection. I am sure I have to go get the calculator, put the numbers in to fully understand what he brings to the game. I know this is a numbers thing, so it is not based off the eye test. You have to go look at the numbers to understand.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on Rudy Gobert's inability to finish
quotes.excerpt: They brought in somebody in LaMelo Ball to create opportunities for Rudy Gobert, and those opportunities have been created.
quotes.quote: They brought in somebody in LaMelo Ball to create opportunities for Rudy Gobert, and those opportunities have been created. He is not finishing the breakfast. I knew it was an issue the moment I saw the interview of him telling the point guard to slow down. I have never seen that. It is more so the audacity. Play your role. We need you to protect the rim, catch the ball when it is thrown to you, and just finish. I don't think it is that difficult, but I am not here to shit on the guy. I do expect more, I do expect better. He is their rim protector, he helps them be the number two defense in the league, all of those things, but shooting 23 percent as a seven-footer, that is just unacceptable. I need better play from him. There is nothing much more to say. We need him to be better.
